posts.caption:

Under a cedar pergola, a stone island anchors the space, and every surface is built for the way people actually entertain.

posts.alt: Six-slide SDLR process carousel of one Rancho Santa Fe estate backyard: the 2D plan, then 3D design renders building out stage by stage (hardscape, planting, pergola, lighting), then the finished build photographed
posts.hook: We design the whole thing in 3D before a single paver is cut.
posts.caption:
Most people meet their backyard for the first time when it is finished. Our clients meet theirs months earlier — in 3D.

Swipe through one outdoor living space, drawing to done:

1. The plan — every grade and dimension resolved on paper.
2. The bones, modeled in 3D — pool, spa, patio, kitchen.
3. The planting goes in.
4. The pergola and the lounge.
5. Then we light it, for the evenings you will use it most.
6. Then we build exactly that.

No surprises. No “that is not what I pictured.” You approve the space before we ever break ground — that is what by design, not by dispatch actually means.

The selections:
• Belgard herringbone paver patio
• raised spa with spillway
• stainless Lynx grill + stacked-stone island
• StruXure louvered pergola
• Warming Trends linear fire feature
• FX Luminaire landscape lighting

Want to see your own outdoor living space in 3D before you commit to a thing? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Aerial view of an Encinitas coastal backyard with a rectangular pool, raised spa, silver travertine deck and the ocean beyond
posts.hook: From above, the whole design reads at once.
posts.caption:
A clean rectangle of water, a raised spa that spills quietly, and travertine that stays cool underfoot — set against the Encinitas coast. Seen from the air you can read the whole plan: how the deck, the pool, and the sightlines were all designed as one.

That is what separates a pool that was installed from a backyard that was designed.

The selections:
• silver travertine deck
• Belgard porcelain pavers
• raised spa with sheer-descent
• frameless glass railing
• coastal drought-tolerant planting
